title: Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2
summary: Meta AI announces Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2, which are AI-powered code generation and creative assistance tools designed to help developers and creators boost productivity through advanced language model capabilities.
problem_solved: Enables faster code development and creative workflows by providing AI-assisted code completion and generation capabilities directly integrated into development environments.
why_valuable: These tools democratize access to powerful code generation AI, helping developers write better code faster while reducing cognitive load during complex programming tasks.
